You may be more likely to strive for personal growth when you see others doing the same. 5. **Sense of belonging**: Feeling connected to a group of like-minded individuals can give you a sense of belonging, which is essential for human well-being. This sense of belonging can motivate you to contribute to the group and work towards common goals. Your group can evolve and adapt to your changing needs and interests, allowing you to explore different aspects of personal growth and development.
